subjects.name: The Way of the Shadow Wolves

summary: Action star Steven Seagal and ex-US Marshal Tom Morrissey self-published a thriller about a Native American tracker fighting a 'deep state' on the Arizona border; it mixes banking conspiracies, anti-Muslim tropes and a foreword by Sheriff Joe Arpaio.
keywords: The Deep State and the Hijacking of America

evidence.note: Host announces the episode is a reading of the Seagal/Morrissey novel
Co-author Morrissey introduced: Brooklyn-born ex-US Marshal, ran for mayor in Arizona
Book described as self-published through a vanity imprint
Publisher's last social post, January 2018, announced the book's release
Seagal's law-enforcement status explained as an honorary Arpaio deputization
Arpaio foreword refers to Trump as sitting president, so written 2017 or later
Preface: deep state run by a church and a banking family; hosts flag antisemitic dog whistle
Novel's Sharia/secret-Muslim plot and pig-blood killing read aloud; several minutes on it
Shadow Wolves identified as a real ICE tracking unit on Tohono O'odham land
Discussion of Seagal's unsupported claim to Native ancestry and appropriation in the book
Book's border passage: media hides drug lords, jihadist caliphate arriving via Mexico
Plot stays in the desert south of Phoenix; body found, deep state suspected

notes: main_span = the book's writing and publication (Arpaio foreword under Trump, 2018 release). covered_span adds Seagal's 1990s-2010s career and misconduct (opening rundown, stuntman story, ancestry claims, ~10% of airtime); 1990 is approximate. Scope local (Arizona) was the alternative.
